O FlowVoice não tem servidor, não pede c: FlowVoice has no server, asks for no account and collects nothing about you. This page explains, without legalese, where everything goes.
Nenhuma gravação é salva em disco. O áud: No recording is saved to disk. The audio goes only to the provider you chose, or nowhere in offline mode. If transcription fails, the recording stays in memory only so you can try again.
Guardadas no Gerenciador de Credenciais: Kept in the Windows Credential Manager; only in rare cases are they stored in a local file (see below).
Pode ser desligado ou apagado quando voc: Can be turned off or deleted whenever you want.
O app não tem analytics, rastreamento ne: The app has no analytics, tracking or usage reports.
Enquanto você dita, o áudio do microfone: While you dictate, the microphone audio stays [1]only in the program's memory[/1]. It is never written to a file and is discarded when the dictation ends.
A única exceção: se a transcrição [1]fal: The only exception: if transcription [1]fails[/1] (no internet, plan limit, invalid key), the recording stays in memory for the [2]Try again[/2] button, at most the last 3 failures. It also never goes to disk: it disappears when you delete the history item, clear the history or close FlowVoice.
Se você usa um provedor na nuvem (Groq,: If you use a cloud provider (Groq, Google Gemini, Mistral, OpenAI, OpenRouter or an address of your own), FlowVoice sends [1]directly to it[/1], with your key:
o áudio, para virar texto;: the audio, to be turned into text;
o texto transcrito, junto com as instruç: the transcribed text, along with the instructions of the chosen style, your vocabulary and the name of the application you are dictating in (so the text comes out in the right tone);
no modo [1]Comando[/1], o texto que você: in [1]Command[/1] mode, the text you selected;
no [1]assistente por voz[/1], a pergunta: in the [1]voice assistant[/1], the question and the conversation. With a Tavily key, the question also goes to Tavily, to search the web.
Não existe servidor do FlowVoice no meio: There is no FlowVoice server in the middle. What each provider does with this data follows its own policy.
[1]Vale saber[/1]No plano grátis do Goog: [1]Good to know[/1]On Google Gemini's free plan, Google may use what you send to improve its products. If that bothers you, prefer another provider or offline mode.
No modo [1]100% local[/1], a transcrição: In [1]100% local[/1] mode, transcription runs on your processor. With Ollama polishing the text, nothing you say leaves your computer.
As chaves ficam no [1]Gerenciador de Cre: Keys stay in the [1]Windows Credential Manager[/1]. They only leave the PC to go to the provider itself, with each request, and appear masked on screen.
Exceção rara: se o cofre não estiver dis: Rare exception: if the vault is unavailable or rejects a key that is too long, it is stored in a file inside the app's settings folder, in your user profile.
O que fica salvo no seu PC: What is saved on your PC
[1]Histórico[/1] dos ditados (texto, est: [1]History[/1] of dictations (text, style and target app), up to the 300 most recent. Turn it off in [2]Settings → General → Keep history[/2], delete items one by one or clear everything on the Home screen.
[1]Offline models[/1] you downloaded. Delete them whenever you want on the models screen.
Um [1]log técnico[/1] para diagnosticar: A [1]technical log[/1] to diagnose problems. It records only technical events (times, errors, response times), never what you dictated. It is limited to about 1 MB (it is recreated when it goes over) and is never sent anywhere: it only leaves the PC if you attach it to a bug report yourself.

[1]Check for updates[/1] on GitHub. Updates are digitally signed.

Nenhuma dessas conexões leva sua voz, se: None of these connections carries your voice, your text or your history.
O app [1]não tem analytics, rastreamento: The app [1]has no analytics, tracking, user identifier or automatic error reporting[/1]. We don't know how many people use it, or how. The code is open: anyone can check it in the [2]GitHub repository[/2].
Este site é estático e hospedado na [1]V: This site is static and hosted on [1]Vercel[/1]. Like any server, Vercel logs technical data about visits (such as IP address and browser) to deliver the pages and protect against abuse, according to [2]its privacy policy[/2].
O site [1]não tem analytics, cookies nem: The site [1]has no analytics, cookies or tracking scripts[/1]. The text font comes from Google Fonts, which receives the request to download it like any server.
There are no forms, logins or ads. The installer is downloaded directly from GitHub.
Dúvidas, pedidos ou algo que parece erra: Questions, requests, or something that looks wrong on this page? Open an issue on GitHub. It is the project's official channel.
Se esta política mudar, a data no topo m: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it, and the change is recorded in the repository history.

Esc não apaga mais o ditado: Esc no longer loses your dictation
Apertar [1]Esc[/1] sem querer no meio de: Pressing [1]Esc[/1] by accident in the middle of a recording used to throw away everything you had said. Now a cancelled dictation is kept.
Um ditado ou tradução cancelado vai para: A cancelled dictation or translation goes to the history marked [1]Cancelled[/1], with the text the live preview was showing at that moment. You can copy it or refine it with the styles right there.
O cartão que aparece depois do [1]Esc[/1: The card that shows up after [1]Esc[/1] has a [2]Transcribe[/2] button: the dictation goes on as if you had stopped normally and is pasted into the same app. In the history, the same button transcribes and copies.
A gravação fica só na memória (as 3 últi: The recording stays in memory only (the last 3, together with failures), never on disk. A quick tap on the shortcut and an [1]Esc[/1] with no speech are still discarded.
